Based on my analysis of the codebase, here are the files that call `makeLocalApiRequest` and would need to be updated for the new signature:

**Direct calls to `makeLocalApiRequest`:**

1. `packages/web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts` (4 calls at lines 127, 1013, 1038, 1067)
2. `packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaces.ts` (1 call at line 97)
3. `packages/remote-web/src/shared/hooks/useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts` (1 call at line 28)

**Type-check impact:**

- `@vibe/web-core` would fail because it has direct calls with the wrong signature
- `@vibe/remote-web` would fail because it has its own direct call AND imports `api.ts` from web-core
- `@vibe/local-web` would fail because it imports and uses APIs from `web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts`, which would have type errors
